feed_title: High Sided Bolster Dog Bed, Green Stonewashed Fabric, Sherpa Fleece Cushion, Washable at 30C, XS 45 x 35cm to XL 90 x 70cm | PawLunova Loweswater
descriptionHtml:
Walls all round. Sherpa in the middle. Sleeping areas listed.

Loweswater is a high sided bolster dog bed in green stonewashed fabric with a sherpa fleece cushion, in five sizes from XS 45 × 35cm to XL 90 × 70cm.

Some dogs drop where they stand. Yours turns, paws at the cushion, turns again, and goes down only when there is give on every side. That circling is not fuss. It is them building a shape.

The sherpa cushion sinks where they press and the walls hold the edges up, so the shape they dig for is already waiting.

What they get

  • Cushioned walls the whole way round: Something to press into whichever way they turn.
  • A deep sherpa fleece cushion: Soft and warm where they actually lie.
  • Springy virgin fibre filling: Soft by design. This is a nest, not a firm foam mattress.
  • Zipped covers that wash at 30°C: Off, in, air-dried, back on.
  • A non-slip base: It grips on wood, laminate and tiles.

Best for: Burrowers and curlers, toy breeds through to retrievers, and draughty rooms.

Why it is worth the money

£79 at XS, £159 at XL. Upholstery-weight stonewashed fabric and a proper sherpa cushion wear differently from printed polyester, and every cover unzips for a 30°C wash. Sizing is the other half. A toy breed is not lost in a bed built for a labrador, because the sleeping area is published for all five.

One number surprises people. The XL is 90 × 70cm outside and gives 72 × 55cm to lie on. Walls that deep come from somewhere.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)Sleeping area (cm)
XS45 × 35 × 2033 × 23
Small55 × 40 × 2242 × 28
Medium65 × 45 × 2548 × 34
Large70 × 55 × 2850 × 42
XL90 × 70 × 3272 × 55

Go by the sleeping area, never the outside. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Remove the zipped covers and machine wash at 30°C. Air-dry, and do not tumble dry.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Read the sleeping area column, not the outside one. Your dog curled must fit inside it.

How much is delivery, and how quickly does it arrive?

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Your postcode estimate sits at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalments are offered among the payment options.

How much do the walls take off the outside measurement?

It varies by size. Both figures are in the table, so you can see what is left.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

Be careful. Walls on every side mean an edge to step over. Ask your vet first.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes, and often. The covers unzip and run at 30°C. Keep them out the dryer.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Not every dog is a burrower. Inside 100 nights we collect free and refund.

Choose by the sleeping area and give them walls to burrow into.
